highlights: Thermal temperature scanners near the main entrance
Full-time School Nurse and Nurse's room
Air purifiers in classrooms for PM2.5 and airborne bacteria reduction
Strict infectious disease and health management protocols
Safer Recruitment Policy and Safeguarding linked policies
safety.policy_summary: Heathfield International School maintains comprehensive health, safety, and safeguarding policies. This includes protocols for managing student health and infectious diseases (such as daily temperature checks, isolation procedures for sick students, and designated classroom/school closure rules during outbreaks), strict air quality control via classroom air purifiers for PM2.5, thermal temperature scanners at the entrance, a designated School Nurse room, and linked safeguarding and safer recruitment policies.
